prices.note: Shopify collection feed mens-outerwear served in USD (Shopify.currency active USD; product .js and analytics show USD, e.g. Men's Snæfell Shell Jacket 610.00 USD): 118 products, product_type Outerlayers only (workwear 'Tops' like the Sif Raincoat and Bottoms excluded): 99 at regular price, none with compare_at_price above price. Low: Höfði Anorak $170; mid: Dyngja Down Bomber $540, Dyngja Down Jacket $620, Snæfell Shell Jacket $610, Þórsmörk Parka $925; high: Jökla Gore-Tex Parka $1,695, Drangajökull Gore-Tex Down Parka $1,750–$1,850.

notes: Homepage meta: '66°North creates premium outerwear designed in Iceland for extreme weather and everyday life. Keeping Iceland warm since 1926.' (https://66north.com/).

About: 'Founded in 1926 to brave the elements' by Hans Kristjánsson in Suðureyri, Westfjords of Iceland, originally Sjóklæðagerð Íslands, protective clothing for workers at sea (https://66north.com/pages/about-us).

Shipping: US DHL Standard $20 (4–6 business days), Express $25; 'Free shipping on all orders over 350 USD'; US orders 'sent on a Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) basis' so duties are included; ships to US, Iceland, Denmark, Europe, UK, Canada, Rest of World (https://66north.com/pages/shipping-and-delivery).
Returns: 30 days for full-price items, 14 for sale; customer pays return shipping unless incorrect or defective (https://66north.com/pages/return).
Store locator footer: 'Visiting Iceland, Denmark or the United Kingdom? Come and meet us!'; no US store named; us_stores left empty (https://66north.com/pages/store-locator).
mens-outerwear size options: S on 116 of 118, XL 113, 2XL 103, XS 90, 3XL 30, 4XL 4, 5XL 3 (https://66north.com/collections/mens-outerwear/products.json).
